title: Sequencing: library talks
bodyMd:
Five talks are delivered in five successive sessions without overlap.

Positions are numbered 1 to 5 in order. The items are Archives, Books, Culture, Design, Education.

- Design must precede Archives.
- Archives must precede Culture.
- Books and Education must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.
- Design must not be in position 1.
